recipe_version.description: Lump crab heaped over crisp romaine with blanched asparagus, boiled eggs, tomatoes, cucumber, and avocado, dressed with a tangy Louie dressing of mayonnaise, ketchup, sweet pickle relish, lemon, scallions, and paprika.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Snap the woody ends off the asparagus, chop the romaine, cut the tomatoes into wedges, slice the cucumber and scallions, and pick over the crab for shell bits.

steps.title: Boil the eggs and asparagus
steps.body: Bring 4 cups water and the salt to a boil in the 2-quart saucepan over high, about 6 minutes to come to a boil. Lower in the eggs and simmer 10 minutes, lift them into a bowl under the cold tap for 2 minutes, then blanch the asparagus in the same pot until bright green, about 2 minutes, and drain under the cold tap. Peel and quarter the eggs.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.body: While the eggs cook (overlap stated): stir the mayonnaise, ketchup, relish, lemon juice, scallions, and paprika in the small bowl.

steps.title: Compose
steps.body: Slice the avocados. Spread the romaine on the platter and arrange the asparagus, eggs, tomatoes, cucumber, and avocado around a central heap of crab. Spoon some dressing over the crab and serve the rest alongside with lemon wedges.

Compared with salade-nicoise-seared-tuna: crab, avocado, and a creamy dressing, not tuna, potatoes, olives, and vinaigrette.
